label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar which is derived from user input param, and although encodeForHTML is applied, the XSS vulnerability exists because the user input flows into the HTML context via the SQL query string that gets printed. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar which is directly concatenated into the SQL query string, making it vulnerable to SQL injection. Both alerts are exploitable, so case TP.

evidence.note: getParameter reads user input into param
map32515 stores param under keyB-32515, then retrieves it as bar
SQL query concatenates bar (user input) directly into SQL string
User input flows into HTML response via encodeForHTML(sql), but still vulnerable to XSS
